next.reason: 1985: "Once the execution of a RECEIVE statement has returned a portion of a message, only subsequent execution of RECEIVE statements"; 2023: "2023 RECEIVE is a message-server feature with no partial messages: if length exceeds identifier-1, EC-MCS-MESSAGE-LENGTH, unsuccessful".
